items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: They had this one more booking that Korko Keith had for them in New York.

ctx.x: He wanted all of them. They had this one more booking that Korko Keith had for them in New York. They were trying to hold together very very much so. But this was the last engagement that Keith was able to get for them. /Korko? Korko?
